title: AXI-Lite Register File
constraints: Eight 32-bit read/write registers at `0x00, 0x04, …, 0x1C` (the register index is `addr[4:2]`, and `addr[1:0]` is ignored). Reset value 0. Writes honor `wstrb`.
Addresses `0x20` and above: **SLVERR** (`2'b10`). Writes have no effect and reads return 0. Everything else responds OKAY.

AXI4-Lite handshake rules: a transfer happens on a rising edge where VALID and READY are both 1. Your slave must accept AW and W in **either order** (or together), must not assert BVALID before both have been accepted, nor RVALID before AR has been accepted, and must hold BVALID/RVALID and their payload stable until BREADY/RREADY. `aresetn` is an active-low synchronous reset. Reads and writes may be in flight at the same time.
hints: Latch AW and W independently into holding registers (`aw_full`, `w_full`), then perform the write once both are full and raise BVALID.
Deassert AWREADY/WREADY while holding a transaction or while BVALID is waiting, so a second write can't overwrite the first.
The read channel is independent: `arready = !rvalid`, and register RDATA/RRESP on the AR handshake.
Decode the error once: `wire werr = wa >= 8'h20;`.
